reason: The Foreknown asked whether a machine that preserves every public warning the moment it is issued can measure the gap between warning and response. Fifty nights of record say it could not, and why. The feeds it could read without a key announce futures hours to days ahead, most of them local US weather warnings; a verdict could say little more than that a warning ran out at its source; and the money and attention it measured belonged to whole countries, never to one warning. Preserving the bytes worked. The question was put to the wrong clock.
kept: Nothing is deleted. Every preserved byte, every dossier, every verdict and every anchor stays here and verifiable; the record simply ends on its last night.
